insight: Founded in 2022 by Princeton classmates from J.P. Morgan and Lazard; a 2026 Kleiner Perkins-led $160M round valued it at $2B.
name: Rogo
tagline: Agentic AI platform for investment banks and asset managers.
description: Rogo is a generative AI platform built specifically for financial services — investment banks, private equity, and asset managers. Its agent Felix executes multi-step deal and investment work, producing auditable Excel models, investment memos, diligence materials, and slide decks. Used by tens of thousands of professionals at hundreds of institutions.

modelSupport.notes: Finance-tuned agentic platform built on frontier LLMs.

edge: Built by ex-bankers for finance; its Felix agent produces auditable, source-attributed Excel models, CIMs, and memos.

references.title: Rogo raises $160M to speed up financial analysis with AI agents
